name: dogfood
description: Production dogfood audit and reporting: 21 read-only checks covering backups, DR, tenancy, licensing, secrets, migrations, monitoring, security, watchdog, and queue health.
author: nself

actions.report: Show the latest saved audit report

notes: This is a CLI-proxy plugin, not a service plugin: it has no port, no HTTP server, and no database tables. `nself plugin install dogfood` must place the built nself-dogfood binary at ~/.nself/plugins/bin/nself-dogfood, where internal/plugin/router.go's ProxyCommand execs it for `nself dogfood <args>` with stdio inherited. Extracted from cli/cmd/commands/dogfood.go and cli/internal/dogfood/ under CLI-R11.
